summary_en: FY12/26 year-end dividend raised ¥2.32/share to ¥50.56 from prior forecast ¥48.24. Dividend policy revised to consolidated-basis thresholds: DOE 8%+ or payout ratio 65% (whichever higher). Effective FY12/26 following acquisition of GMO Digital Lab as subsidiary on 1 Jul 2026. Payout ratio floor and DOE floor unchanged.
title_en: Notice regarding change in dividend policy and revision to FY12/26 dividend forecast (increase)
translation_en_brief: On 15 June 2026, GMO Commerce's board approved an increase to the FY12/26 year-end dividend and a revision to dividend policy. The year-end dividend per share is raised by ¥2.32 to ¥50.56, up from the prior forecast of ¥48.24. The policy change reflects the company's planned acquisition of 100% of GMO Digital Lab, effective 1 July 2026, which will shift GMO Commerce's financial basis from standalone to consolidated reporting beginning FY12/26. Under the revised policy, dividends will be set at the higher of a consolidated-basis DOE floor of 8% or a consolidated-basis payout ratio of 65%. The company states that the absolute levels of the payout ratio (65%) and DOE (8%) targets remain unchanged, and the fundamental principle of stable and continuous dividend distribution is preserved. Reserved capital is to be deployed for existing operations and growth investments to enhance enterprise value.
